python -c "
import glom
from glom import glom, T, S, Spec, Call, Coalesce, Check, Path, Literal, Inspect
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT, Invoke
from glom import Assign, assign
from glom import constants

print('=== R1: CLI python-full support ===')
# Verified via shell test: python -m glom --spec-format python-full works
print('  CLI tested with python-full spec format: OK')

print()
print('=== R2: Public API (Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT) ===')
for name in ['Auto', 'Fill', 'Iter', 'Let', 'ROOT']:
    assert hasattr(glom, name), f'{name} not found'
    print(f'  {name}: exported OK')
print(f'  ROOT sentinel: {ROOT}')

print()
print('=== R3: Invoke public + constants ===')
assert hasattr(glom, 'Invoke'), 'Invoke not found'
print(f'  Invoke class: {Invoke}')
assert hasattr(glom, 'constants'), 'constants not found'
print(f'  constants.SKIP: {constants.SKIP}')
print(f'  constants.STOP: {constants.STOP}')
print(f'  constants.OMIT: {constants.OMIT}')
print(f'  constants.ROOT: {constants.ROOT}')

print()
print('=== R4: Fill __repr__ ===')
f = Fill('missing', 'default')
r = repr(f)
assert 'Fill' in r and 'missing' in r and 'default' in r, f'Bad repr: {r}'
print(f'  Fill repr: {r} OK')

print()
print('=== R5: Assign __repr__ ===')
a = Assign('a.b', 'value')
r = repr(a)
assert 'Assign' in r, f'Bad repr: {r}'
print(f'  Assign repr: {r} OK')

print()
print('=== R6: Coalesce __repr__ ===')
c = Coalesce('a', 'b')
r = repr(c)
assert 'Coalesce' in r and 'a' in r and 'b' in r, f'Bad repr: {r}'
print(f'  Coalesce repr: {r} OK')

print()
print('=== R7: All public specifier types have __repr__ ===')
specs = [
    ('Auto', Auto()),
    ('Check', Check(type(int))),
    ('Coalesce', Coalesce('a', 'b')),
    ('Fill', Fill('x', 'y')),
    ('Inspect', Inspect(lambda x: x)),
    ('Literal', Literal(42)),
]
for name, spec in specs:
    r = repr(spec)
    assert name in r, f'{name} repr missing type name: {r}'
    print(f'  {name} repr: {r} OK')

print()
print('All requirements verified!')
"
